title: Verify Valid Patient Login & Dashboard Redirection
desc: Verifies that a registered female patient can successfully authenticate with valid credentials, receive a secure JWT token, and transition to the Patient Health Dashboard.
precond: User account is registered in PostgreSQL database and device has internet/ADB network connectivity.
postcond: User session is established with authenticated JWT token stored in secure storage.

steps.step: Launch mobile application and navigate to Login screen
steps.expected: App launches successfully and displays the Sign In screen with input fields
steps.actual: App opened cleanly on Android 14; Sign In screen displayed

steps.step: Verify Email input field accessibility and placeholder
steps.expected: Email field is visible, focused, and accepts alphanumeric input
steps.actual: Field located and ready for input

steps.step: Enter valid registered patient email address
steps.expected: Email address is typed accurately into the text field
steps.actual: Email entered successfully

steps.step: Enter valid patient password
steps.expected: Password text is masked securely and accepted
steps.actual: Password characters masked and entered

steps.step: Click on the Login submit button
steps.expected: Authentication request sent to backend API (POST /api/auth/login)
steps.actual: HTTP 200 OK received with valid JWT Bearer token

steps.step: Verify transition to Patient Dashboard
steps.expected: User lands on Home Dashboard showing daily summary and health score
steps.actual: Dashboard rendered with patient greeting and metrics

title: Verify Appointment Reservation Submission to Express API
desc: Verifies submitting appointment reservation sends POST /api/appointments payload and receives confirmation ID with calendar invite.
precond: Doctor, type, date, and slot configured in booking form.
postcond: Appointment record persisted in PostgreSQL and calendar event created.

steps.step: Verify all appointment form criteria in summary card
steps.data: Doctor: Dr. Sarah Jenkins; Slot: 10:00 AM; Type: Virtual
steps.expected: Summary card accurately reflects choices
steps.actual: Summary card verified

steps.step: Click 'Confirm Booking' submission button
steps.expected: Loading spinner displays on button while dispatching request
steps.actual: Loading spinner shown; request dispatched

steps.step: Monitor network payload for POST /api/appointments
steps.expected: HTTP 201 Created returned with appointment confirmation ID
steps.actual: HTTP 201 Created received with ID #1042

steps.step: Verify Booking Confirmed success modal displays
steps.expected: Dialog appears with teleconsultation link and calendar button
steps.actual: Success dialog rendered with appointment summary

steps.step: Confirm appointment appears under Upcoming Consultations
steps.expected: Appointment visible in patient queue with 'Confirmed' badge
steps.actual: Appointment visible in directory with green status badge

title: Verify Opening Universal Wearable Pairing Interface
desc: Verifies navigating to Devices tab opens the Universal Wearables Pairing Hub with camera QR scanner and brand adapters.
precond: User logged into FemSphere on Android device.
postcond: Wearables pairing interface initialized and ready for scanning.

steps.step: Navigate to Connected Devices view via bottom navigation
steps.expected: Connected Devices view displays paired devices and pairing CTA
steps.actual: Devices view rendered with 'Connect New Device' button

steps.step: Tap on 'Connect New Wearable' button
steps.expected: Pairing hub launches with QR scanning viewport and brand filters
steps.actual: Pairing hub opened cleanly

steps.step: Verify device category tabs render horizontally
steps.data: Categories: Smartwatches, Fitness Bands, Smart Rings
steps.expected: Filter pills render horizontally without clipping
steps.actual: Category pills displayed with active filter styling

title: Verify Menstrual Cycle Phase Prediction & 28-Day Baseline Calibration
desc: Verifies that the Digital Health Twin calculates current menstrual cycle day, predicts upcoming fertile window and period onset, and displays phase recommendations.
precond: User has recorded last menstrual period start date 14 days prior.
postcond: Cycle stage synchronized across mobile dashboard and twin model.

steps.step: Navigate to Period Tracker & Cycle Intelligence module
steps.expected: Cycle tracker dashboard displays circular phase gauge and calendar
steps.actual: Cycle dashboard rendered with current day indicator

steps.step: Verify current cycle day calculation from last period onset
steps.expected: System computes Cycle Day 14 (Ovulatory Phase window)
steps.actual: Cycle Day 14 displayed with 'High Fertility' indicator

steps.step: Inspect next period start date prediction
steps.expected: System predicts period onset in 14 days based on historical average
steps.actual: Next period countdown displayed: '14 days remaining'

steps.step: Verify hormonal phase lifestyle and nutrition advice card
steps.expected: Informational card recommends hydration, antioxidant nutrition, and light exercise
steps.actual: Nutrition and wellness recommendation cards loaded for Ovulatory phase

steps.step: Confirm cycle calendar displays projected fertile days
steps.expected: Fertile days highlighted with distinctive purple gradient markers
steps.actual: Calendar displays 5-day fertile window with correct visual badges

banner: Gemini AI OCR Engine Test Case
title: Verify Gemini 2.5 Flash OCR Biomarker Table Rendering
desc: Verifies that the Gemini AI OCR engine parses diagnostic lab PDF, extracts biomarker key-values, and renders structured results table.
precond: Lab report uploaded with OCR processing completed.
postcond: Biomarkers parsed and mapped into Digital Twin metabolic profile.

steps.step: Open details for processed lab report
steps.expected: Report details screen opens with tabs: 'Original File' & 'AI Insights'
steps.actual: Report details loaded with OCR results view

steps.step: Inspect AI Biomarkers Extraction table
steps.expected: Table renders columns: Biomarker Name, Value, Reference Range, Status
steps.actual: Biomarker table visible with parsed laboratory readings

steps.step: Verify extracted hemoglobin reading and reference status
steps.expected: Hemoglobin classified as 'Normal' with green badge
steps.actual: Reading parsed accurately as 13.8 g/dL with green Normal badge

steps.step: Verify extracted ferritin reading and reference status
steps.expected: Ferritin flagged as 'Low-Normal' with nutritional iron recommendation
steps.actual: Low-normal iron alert rendered with twin diet recommendation
